categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp and wallet test files to change how the wallet rebroadcasts transactions, matching the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a long-standing privacy leak where nodes leak network IP identity simply by passively running a wallet. As noted in issue #3828 and the description, observers can send low-fee incoming transactions to associate a node's IP address with target wallet addresses upon rebroadcast.
